inputs.note: app.retrieval.query_guard, against the canary values in fixtures/phi/canary_patient.json. Three layers are checked: the input type has no patient field, assert_concept_only rejects identifier shapes, and build_query re-runs the guard over bare strings — the path the bake-off harness takes, which does not go through the contract at all and is the one run that actually leaves the machine.

expected: A retrieval query carries clinical concepts only. The canary MRN, a name with a date of birth, an SSN, a US date, an email and a phone number are each rejected; an ordinary clinical concept is not; and the bare-string path is guarded too.
guards_against: PHI reaching a third-party embedder or reranker — the leak with the longest blast radius, because it leaves the BAA-covered boundary.
